dataset_a_vedo_ocr.name: VedoOCR — Vedic Sanskrit Manuscript OCR Dataset
dataset_a_vedo_ocr.intended_role: Source manuscript images, character/word visual patterns, baseline OCR evaluation, and source for controlled synthetic degradation pairs.

ocr.evidence: 681 line crops from 57 ancient pages paired with expert ground-truth transcriptions in master.tsv and splits/*.tsv.

image_restoration.evidence: Provides authentic Vedic manuscript images as targets for controlled synthetic degradation. Genuine paired degraded/clean manuscript scans do not exist in the raw dataset.

damage_detection.evidence: Supports synthetic damage detection by generating exact pixel-level masks during controlled degradation. Raw data has no physical damage annotations.

missing_text_prediction.evidence: Supplies 41,286 Vedic character transcriptions and 87 grapheme classes for n-gram character/word language model training.

dataset_b_sanskrit_hindi_vqa.name: Sanskrit and Hindi OCR VQA Dataset
dataset_b_sanskrit_hindi_vqa.intended_role: Document images and textual Q&A annotations for contextual text prediction and Devanagari OCR evaluation.

ocr.evidence: 6,666 word/phrase images paired with ground-truth Devanagari text files across train (5,000), val (600), and test (1,066) splits.

image_restoration.classification: Not supported by the inspected data
image_restoration.evidence: Contains clean word/scene crops and VQA photos, not paired degraded/clean historical manuscript folios. Can only serve as secondary synthetic source images.

damage_detection.classification: Not supported by the inspected data
damage_detection.evidence: No damage masks, bounding boxes, or degradation labels exist in this dataset.

missing_text_prediction.evidence: 16,752 question-answer sentence triples and 6,666 OCR transcriptions in Hindi and Sanskrit supply extensive Devanagari vocabulary for context prediction.

synthetic_data.name: Past2Pixel Controlled Synthetic Degradation Pairs
synthetic_data.intended_role: Clean vs Degraded training pairs with ground-truth damage masks.

image_restoration.evidence: Synthetic pipeline generates aligned clean and degraded image pairs with mathematical ground truth for PSNR/SSIM evaluation.

damage_detection.evidence: Exact pixel-level binary masks generated for all injected stains, tears, fading, and noise, enabling IoU and Dice metric evaluation.
